evidence: no-supplementary-groups: user_base.pp:65 'groups => $mygrouplist' with user.pp:6's default [] (the base fixture passes no list) means no supplementary groups, so 'id -nG' printing only p8testuser is what the code produces

the-given-key-is-pushed: user_base.pp:94 'if ( $ignorekey == false )' is the only guard on ssh_authorized_key (96-100, type ssh-rsa, title <user>@puppet); the wrapper (user.pp:8) cannot pass ignorekey so the default false applies, and with an unlocked hash and non-empty mykey $sshkey = $mykey (58); the expected single 'ssh-rsa <RSA body> p8testuser@puppet' line matches

home-created-and-owned: user_base.pp:69 'managehome => true' creates /home/<title> (myhome '' -> /home/${myusername}, lines 8-10) owned by the user and its primary group (= title with an empty group list, 25-26); stat '%U %G %F' = 'p8testuser p8testuser directory' is what that yields

purpose covered: Purpose (user.pp header 'a normal user not belonging to any special groups'; line 8 passes every parameter to user_base, never ignorekey/myppsigs/myppwrapped) is stated right. Checks test the account, own primary group, comment, home, shell and no extra groups; the hash and a real su login with the test password plus refusal of a wrong one; the key pushed as the only key in a private user-owned file; no ecryptfs files; the purge of a planted out-of-band key by an agent run (its mutates now names the /run key pair it writes); variants locked (locked hash -> passwd -S L and the userlocked placeholder, group list [users] as primary, /srv/p8testhome mode 700, /bin/sh) and emptykey (mykey '' -> the emptykey placeholder), both ALL_PASS in my run. Uncovered, honestly: the empty-hash fail() (a compile refusal; phase3.py run_locked returns APPLY_FAILED on a red harness, verified at phase3.py:1226-1227) and a login with the pushed key (no private half; fetch_node_files only reads node files, phase3.py:944-949), each lifted by a named capability. The wrapper's own default mykey 'dummykey' takes the same pushed-key branch (user_base.pp:56-58) as the tested fixture key, so it adds no untested behaviour.
